definitions.explanation: The bright flash of light produced by lightning during a thunderstorm, as distinct from the sound of thunder.

examples.japanese: {稲光|いなびかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}った→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: A flash of lightning streaked across the sky.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}く⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{稲光|いなびかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a flash of lightning in the distance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、{稲光|いなびかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜空|よぞら}→夜空：09591_yozora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{照|て}らした→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: In the heavy rain, flashes of lightning lit up the night sky again and again.

notes:
Refers specifically to the visible flash of lightning, as opposed to the sound of thunder. ⟦{稲|いね}→稲：01820_ine⟧ ('rice plant') is in the word because lightning was traditionally believed to help rice ripen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {稲光|いなびかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: a flash of lightning streaks across the sky
- {稲光|いなびかり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: lightning flashes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{稲妻|いなずま}→稲妻：04989_inazuma⟧: lightning; lightning bolt — near-synonym, often of the jagged bolt itself
- ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧: thunder; lightning — the general word, covering both the flash and the sound
